rules.headline: Qualify: Orchid Retail, ₹29,00,000, inside the mandate

gemini.headline: Qualify clean 10-seat expansion for Orchid Retail with COO sign-off.
gemini.reasoning: This is a routine upsell with an established client that has no overdue invoices and confirmed COO budget. The payment terms are well within standard limits and the service line is core. We should proceed immediately to contracting at the agreed rates.

request.description: Cobalt Fintech enquiry for an L1 IT service desk; CTO engaged, budget approved.

rules.headline: Qualify: Cobalt Fintech, ₹36,00,000, inside the mandate

gemini.headline: Qualify Cobalt Fintech's L1 IT service desk enquiry immediately.
gemini.reasoning: This is a clean, routine deal with an existing client where the CTO is directly engaged and the budget is already confirmed. Payment terms of 45 days and manageable competition of two vendors fit our core criteria perfectly. With no outstanding red flags or mandate blocks, this should proceed through the standard pipeline without friction.

request.description: Palmyra Hotels wants a seasonal reservations desk; budget approved, GM signing, asks for 80-day payment terms.

rules.headline: Qualify with conditions: Palmyra Hotels, only with the conditions below

gemini.headline: Qualify seasonal desk with mandatory milestone billing and verified credit protections.
gemini.reasoning: Palmyra Hotels has an engaged GM and confirmed budget, making this a qualified opportunity. However, 80-day payment terms pose working capital risks for a seasonal deployment. We will proceed only with advance milestones and a clear credit check to protect our cash flow.

request.description: Nilgiri Foods is interested in finance-ops support but has not got a budget line yet.

gemini.headline: Ask the requester to confirm budget approval status and timeline before committing sales pursuit effort.
gemini.reasoning: We do not deploy pursuit bandwidth on unbudgeted initiatives without understanding the funding path and timeline. While a decision-maker is engaged and commercial terms look standard, we need to verify whether this is an active buying project or an exploratory price check against two competitors. Clarifying the budget owner and allocation schedule upfront will determine if this deal is real.

request.description: Mercury Edtech: an analyst asked for a proposal for data operations; no senior contact yet.

gemini.headline: Ask the account manager to establish decision-maker access before submitting a proposal.
gemini.reasoning: A deal without a named decision-maker is merely a conversation, not a qualified lead. We should not expend solutioning effort for an analyst request without knowing who owns the budget and signs off. Once we verify the economic buyer and decision timeline, we can evaluate whether to proceed.

request.description: Lumina Bank wants to extend reconciliation and add month-end close: ₹1.9 Cr a year.

rules.headline: Escalate Lumina Bank to Vikram: outside the mandate

gemini.headline: Escalate ₹1.9 Cr Lumina Bank upsell to Vikram Sethi due to contract value exceeding delegated authority.
gemini.reasoning: This is a solid upsell opportunity with a clean existing banking client and sound commercial terms. However, at ₹1.9 Cr ACV, it surpasses the ₹1.5 Cr threshold for account manager sign-off and requires formal approval. We should verify overdue invoice status before final sign-off.

request.description: Partner referral from Indus Ports Authority for data-entry work at 90-day terms.

rules.headline: Escalate Indus Ports Authority to Vikram: outside the mandate

gemini.headline: Escalate Indus Ports Authority lead to Vikram due to government entity procurement rules and extended payment risks.
gemini.reasoning: Indus Ports Authority is a public sector entity requesting 90-day payment terms without clear billing safeguards, presenting significant working-capital exposure. Under our mandate and lessons learned from past public-sector contracts, all government accounts require executive approval and strict cash-flow protections before proceeding. Vikram must evaluate whether we can enforce milestone billing or an advance before qualifying this bid.

request.description: Enquiry for us to build and run an AI model red-teaming team.

rules.headline: Escalate Other / new prospect to Vikram: outside the mandate

gemini.headline: Escalate to Vikram and delivery leadership to evaluate entering an unbuilt AI red-teaming capability.
gemini.reasoning: This opportunity involves building and running an AI model red-teaming team, which is a new capability outside our current delivery footprint. Under our mandate, pursuing an unproven capability bet requires direct sign-off from sales leadership and delivery heads. While the commercial terms and budget look sound, we cannot commit delivery resources without leadership review.

request.description: Vertex Logistics wants 15 more tracking-desk seats at the same 45-day terms. Note from finance: their last two invoices are 75 days overdue.

cases.why: Upsell held: two invoices 75 days overdue (SL04).
cases.meera_note: Upsell held: two invoices 75 days overdue (SL04).

rules.headline: Qualify: Vertex Logistics, ₹52,00,000, inside the mandate

gemini.headline: Hold the upsell until the 75-day overdue invoices are cleared or secured.
gemini.reasoning: We grow accounts that pay and fix the ones that do not before expanding them. Vertex Logistics currently has two invoices overdue by 75 days, which presents an unacceptable credit risk under our rules. We need a confirmed clearance plan or settlement from their finance team before committing additional capacity.

request.description: Garnet Pharma wants to try our data-cleansing team: they ask for a 6-week free pilot before signing anything.

cases.why: Wanted a free 6-week pilot; offered paid pilot (SL03).
cases.meera_note: Wanted a free 6-week pilot; offered paid pilot (SL03).

rules.headline: Qualify: Garnet Pharma, ₹26,00,000, inside the mandate

gemini.headline: Qualify subject to converting the proposed free pilot into a paid pilot with explicit exit criteria.
gemini.reasoning: We do not do free pilots under any circumstances, as they lead to scope creep and uncommitted buyers. This deal fits our core service and budget mandate, but it can only proceed if structured as a paid pilot with fixed duration and measurable sign-off criteria. The pilot fees can be credited against the annual contract once the full agreement is executed.

request.description: Partner referral: 50-seat consumer helpdesk for a power distributor. The partner mentions the buyer is a subsidiary of the state electricity board.

cases.why: Buyer turned out to be a state-board subsidiary (SL02).
cases.meera_note: Buyer turned out to be a state-board subsidiary (SL02).

rules.headline: Qualify: Other / new prospect, ₹64,00,000, inside the mandate

gemini.headline: Escalate to Vikram due to state electricity board subsidiary ownership requiring strict milestone billing safeguards.
gemini.reasoning: Although marked as a non-government entity, this power distributor is a subsidiary of a state electricity board and carries public sector collection risks. Under our policy, any state-owned or PSU subsidiary requires explicit milestone billing or a mobilisation advance before we commit delivery resources. Vikram's direct review is needed to validate commercial protections and confirm whether our team has direct access to the signatory rather than relying entirely on partner assurances.

In line with my principle that a deal without an identified decision-maker is merely a conversation, we must clarify who owns the sign-off and ensure the commercial terms remain untouched before progressing.
